values.name: Debit advice
values.description: Receiver of the payment message needs to return a debit advice in response to the payment message.

values.name: Message acknowledgement
values.description: Indicates that an acknowledgement relating to receipt of message is required.

values.name: Acknowledge - with detail and change
values.description: Acknowledge complete including changes.

values.name: Acknowledge - with detail, no change
values.description: Acknowledge complete without changes.

values.name: Debit advice for each transaction
values.description: A debit advice is requested for each transaction in the message.

values.name: Debit advice/message acknowledgement
values.description: The sender wishes to receive both a Debit Advice and an acknowledgement of receipt for a payment message.

values.name: Authentication
values.description: Authentication, by a party, of a document established for him by another party.

values.name: Debit advice/message acknowledgement for each transaction
values.description: A debit advice and message acknowledgement are requested for each transaction in the message.

values.name: Acknowledge only changes
values.description: Acknowledgement of changes only is required.

values.name: Pending
values.description: Indication that the referenced offer or transaction (e.g. cargo booking or quotation request) is being dealt with.

values.name: Accepted
values.description: Indication that the referenced offer or transaction (e.g., cargo booking or quotation request) has been accepted.

values.name: Response expected
values.description: The sender of the message expects a response.

values.name: Direct documentary credit collection
values.description: Documentary credit collection forwarded directly.

values.name: Credit advice and message acknowledgement
values.description: The receiver of the message is to acknowledge receipt of the message and sent a credit advice for each credit.

values.name: Conditionally accepted
values.description: Indication that the referenced offer or transaction (e.g., cargo booking or quotation request) has been accepted under conditions indicated in this message.

values.name: Confirmation of measurements
values.description: Indication that the message contains the physical measurements on which the charges will be based.

values.name: No acknowledgement needed
values.description: Specifies that no acknowledgement is needed in response to this message.

values.name: Rejected
values.description: Indication that the referenced offer or transaction (e.g., cargo booking or quotation request) is not accepted.

values.name: Credit advice
values.description: The message recipient is to send a credit advice in response to the message.

values.name: Acknowledgement when error
values.description: An acknowledgement is requested when an error occurred.

values.name: Acknowledgment due to error
values.description: An acknowledgment is sent because an error was identified in the received message.

values.name: Alternate date
values.description: The solution proposed in the response applies to another date than the one requested.

values.name: Alternate service
values.description: The solution proposed in the response applies to another service than the one requested.
